policy.tool: Built-in GPT Image; no Python cutouts or hidden substitute generation.
policy.rgb: Only integrated mother-scene RGB supplies visible character colors; figure/mask RGB is not used as replacement art.
policy.alpha: Same-canvas masks may include low-opacity raw exterior pixels; runtime alpha transfer and actual composite review remain necessary.
policy.cleanPlate: Generative inpainting reconstructs occluded surfaces; it is not a photograph or guaranteed pixel-identical original room.
policy.geography: The imagined campus view is atmospheric illustration, not real map/navigation data.
policy.scope: User-authorized source synchronization to current repository; no additional mobile app, deployment, private user text, account data, credentials or secret included.
policy.review: Image review confirmation is bound to an explicit primary-agent approval and matching output SHA-256, or to the earlier primary-agent review snapshot. It does not certify every runtime composition or drag combination.
